text:
marta: quick heads-up — noticed a regression in TP+PP jobs on the 8xA100 hosts after the recent kernel selector tweak.
jun: ah — regression details?
marta: p50 token latency up ~15% for beam workloads when tensors span NVLink islands -> some ranks hit PCIe more often.
sam: same hosts, or only cross-rack?
marta: same rack, 2 NVLink islands per host. baseline (old selector) had better locality. new selector chooses kernel variant that favors compute throughput but increases all-reduce message count.
ryan: do you have profiler traces?
marta: pasted a trimmed trace below:

```
# timeline (ms)
rank0: compute 0-10 | allreduce 10-42 | compute 42-60
rank1: compute 0-10 | allreduce 10-55 | compute 55-60
kvcache-prefetch: hits drop 12% -> more cache misses
net: nvlink saturated at 80% while pcie links spike at 60% (cross-island)
```
jun: interesting — allreduce window increased and lost overlap with compute on some ranks. Kernel choice likely expanded message fragmentation.
sam: sounds like smaller fragments -> more stalling while we wait for matching peers over PCIe. Could be our fragmentation heuristic in the kernel selector.
ryan: agility plan:
1) repro with perf harness on 8xA100, toggle selector flag
2) try fused-allreduce kernel (less messages) vs ring (more parallelism)
3) topology-aware placement: prefer allocating TP shards inside NVLink island when possible
jun: I can run the perf harness. command i used yesterday:

```
./run_profiler.sh --model gpt-medium --tp 2 --pp 4 --batch 8 --selector experimental_v2 --out /tmp/prof
```
marta: when you run, add `--collect-netstats` so we get per-link counters.
infra-bot: new job queued: infra/8xA100/prof-1749994321 (ETA 12m)
sam: another angle: KV cache prefetch window looks too small — more KV misses increase cross-node data movement. We should bump prefetch from 16->64 sequence chunks for this workload.
jun: good call. also add a metric to the console: allreduce/sync-latency per-step and message-count-per-step.
ryan: also test pinning fabric affinity: prefer NVLink local ranks by setting placement policy to "island-first" and see if latency returns.
marta: can someone check whether the kernel selector changed the reduce-splitting threshold? I recall a change that splits >256k messages into 8 fragments.
sam: yes, PR #3412 introduced adaptive split for "high-latency" heuristic. It used a rough bandwidth estimate that doesn't account for NVLink islands.
jun: temporary quickfix: force max-frag-size to 512k in selector, repro, and compare.
ryan: if that helps, longer-term we need topology-aware split: if link within island, allow smaller fragments; if crossing PCIe, prefer fewer larger messages.
marta: putting action items:
- jun: run the repro with selector toggles + collect-netstats (ETA 2h)
- sam: prototype prefetch bump and frag-size override in a branch (ETA EOD)
- ryan: add console metric (allreduce-count/step) and heatmap for per-link util (ETA 48h)
- infra-bot: schedule larger run on a cross-island stressed host for regression test
jun: starting the run now. cc @sam I'll push the prefetch test after I have baseline.
sam: thanks — if we get <5% delta after frag-size bump, we can revert that selector change temporarily.
marta: :thumbsup: keep updates here. if we confirm topology-affinity fix helps, we should make selector topology-aware as default.
ryan: noted — I'll draft the selector change doc if experiments confirm.
jun: logs incoming in ~15m, will paste short summary here.
infra-bot: job infra/8xA100/prof-1749994321 completed: artifacts at s3://redwood-prod/prof/1749994321
marta: got the artifacts — initial numbers look promising with frag-size override: p50 down to baseline+2% (from +15%). KV hits recovered ~9%.
sam: nice. next step is validating across other models (longer seq) — I'll run a sweep overnight.
jun: thanks everyone. follow-ups in the morning.
